newsitem.title: USA: ACC files for sale of shrs by holders.
newsitem.headline: ACC files for sale of shrs by holders.

text.p: ACC Corp, a telecommunications holding company, said it had filed a registration statement on Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to facilitate the sale of about 1.228 million shares of common stock by shareholders.
The company said in a statement Fleet Equity Partners owned all preferred stock and would convert those shares into 937,500 shares of common stock. They will be included in the offering.
The preferred shares bear dividends at 12 percent a year, and have had the effect of decreasing earnings per share in prior periods.
"The conversion of the preferred stock will substantially reduce ACC's ongoing fixed payment obligations," the statement said.
The managing underwriters for the offering are Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Wheat First Butcher Singer.
Robert Van Degna, a partner with Fleet Equity, joined the board of directors in May 1995. He will continue as a director with ACC Corp.
Further details were not immediately available.
